The '''Little Talhovi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Little Talhovi]].
